**Finding submitted: deviation (fallback target).**

- **Responsive locations reviewed:** § 1.4 (p0008–p0009) — the only inbound grant to us (access to and right to use HDI's computer system, software and Content administration tools); § 6.1 (p0038–p0039) — outbound trademark licence of our "Deerskin" Marks to HDI, not flagged as it benefits us; § 4.1 term/termination; § 10.3 assignment (p0063).
- **Why it fails fallback:** the § 1.4 right runs to "the Company" only; "affiliate" and "contractor" appear nowhere in the document, and § 10.3 states that "no other person shall acquire or have any rights under this Agreement" — affiliates excluded with no path to add them.
- **Already met:** § 10.3 makes the Agreement binding on and enforceable by the parties' legal representatives, successors and assigns, covering successor transfer in an M&A.
- **Change made:** one inserted sentence after § 1.4 extending the access and use rights to any Company affiliate identified to HDI by written notice — validated with `ok:true` and passing the minimality gate.
- **Noted, not redlined:** contractor coverage and perpetual/irrevocable paid-up or subscription-termination mechanics (preferred wording only; no paid-up or subscription licence exists in this term hosting arrangement).
